text: Who are the best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Perth? Give me a shortlist of reputable Power Platform consulting partners with reasons.

result.keyword: Who are the best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Perth? Give me a shortlist of reputable Power Platform consulting partners with reasons.

items.markdown:
Here is a shortlist of reputable Microsoft Power Platform consulting partners operating in Perth, Western Australia, known for their `delivery across Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Copilot Studio/AI integration`:

- **Velrada** 
	- **Overview:** Headquartered in Perth with a large global and national footprint, Velrada is a premier, award-winning Microsoft Cloud Solution Partner.
	- **Why them:** They have extensive enterprise-grade experience deploying large-scale digital transformations. They excel at integrating the full Microsoft stack (Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and Azure) and are well-regarded for heavy industry, government, and large corporate deployments in WA. You can explore their capabilities on the Velrada site.[[1]](https://revenuebase.ai/companies/microsoft-power-platform-consultants/australia)
- **Bremmar** 
	- **Overview:** A prominent Perth-based IT and Microsoft cloud consultancy with a strong focus on mid-sized businesses, not-for-profits, aged care, and community service sectors.
	- **Why them:** Bremmar focuses heavily on change enablement, process digitisation, and operational efficiency using Power Platform and Microsoft 365. They are a great match if you need a partner who can align low-code automation and apps closely with everyday team collaboration and user adoption. Learn more via Bremmar Consulting.[[1]](https://bremmar.com.au/microsoft-power-platform-perth/)
- **Monarch360** 
	- **Overview:** A specialized Microsoft partner delivering robust Power Platform solutions (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Pages) across Australia, including a dedicated Perth presence.
	- **Why them:** They focus squarely on streamlining workflows, eliminating manual data entry, and building tailored business intelligence or operational apps for enterprise and government clients. Check out their specific offerings on Monarch360 Microsoft Power Platform Services.[[1]](https://www.monarch360.com.au/microsoft-power-platform)
- **Opticloud Solutions** 
	- **Overview:** A nimble Perth-based consultancy specializing in modern Microsoft cloud solutions, end-to-end Power Platform development, and cutting-edge AI integrations.
	- **Why them:** Aside from standard low-code apps and Power Automate workflows, Opticloud has a strong emphasis on emerging tech like custom Copilot Studio AI agents and advanced analytics, making them ideal if you want to infuse AI directly into your data processes. Discover more at Opticloud Solutions.[[1]](https://opticloud.com.au/solutions/)

To help narrow down which of these consultants fits best, tell me:

- What is your **primary goal** (e.g., custom mobile apps, workflow automation, complex Power BI reporting, or AI/Copilot integration)?
- What is the **scale of your organization** (SMB, enterprise, or government)?
